g.text: Notation "x + y" := (plus x y) (at level 50, left associativity) : nat_scope.Notation "x * y" := (mult x y) (at level 40, left associativity) : nat_scope.1+2*3*4 parses as 1+((2*3)*4)

Precedence levels range from 0 to 100.Associativity may be left, right, or no associativity.Context often identifies the scope: S (O*O) uses nat_scope;the pair type bool*bool uses type_scope.(x*y)%nat makes the intended scope explicit.0%nat means O; 0%Z means the integer zero.Optional sections may be skimmed on a first reading.The source cautions that the notation mechanism is limited.
